facts.text: The hotel is the only property on the coastal road that links Cape Town and Camps Bay with Llandudno Beach and Hout Bay.
facts.excerpt: The only property located on the spectacular coastal road that links Cape Town and Camps Bay with Llundudno Beach and Hout Bay beyond

facts.text: The coastal road between Camps Bay and Llandudno is an undeveloped conservation area, with fynbos-clad mountainside on one side and the Atlantic Ocean on the other.
facts.excerpt: The coastal road between Camps Bay and Llandudno is a conservation area so it’s undeveloped—fynbos-clad mountainside to one side and the vast expanse of the Atlantic Ocean to the other.

facts.text: The hotel is named after the Twelve Apostles mountain range, which runs parallel to the coast from Camps Bay to Llandudno.
facts.excerpt: the hotel, which is named after the Twelve Apostles mountain range that runs parallel to the coast from Camps Bay to Llandudno

facts.text: The hotel is built into the contours of the mountainside on a relatively small footprint.
facts.excerpt: Built into the contours of the mountainside, there’s a lot of hotel packed into its relatively small footprint.

facts.text: In 1929 Jack van Breda designed the original house in the style of Sir Herbert Baker, with two big white frontal gables and a thatched roof.
facts.excerpt: In 1929, Jack van Breda designed a handsome house, after the style of Sir Herbert Baker, with two big white frontal gables and a thatched roof.

facts.text: In March 2002 the hotel became part of the family-owned Red Carnation Hotels and was renamed The Twelve Apostles Hotel and Spa.
facts.excerpt: In March 2002 the hotel became part of the family-owned Red Carnation Hotels and was re-named The Twelve Apostles Hotel and Spa.

facts.text: Alien plant species around the hotel were removed and extensive indigenous gardens were cultivated.
facts.excerpt: Around the hotel, alien plant species were removed and extensive indigenous gardens were cultivated.

facts.text: The rooms were designed and decorated by the owners, the Tollmans, in a flamboyant, old-school glamour style.
facts.excerpt: Flamboyant, old-school glamour best describes the Twelve Apostles’ luxuriously appointed rooms, designed and decorated by the owners, the Tollmans.

facts.text: Every room's layout and decoration is slightly different, with matching wallpaper and fabrics, elegant mirrors and original art.
facts.excerpt: Although every room’s layout and decoration is slightly different, the overriding effect is riotous pattern (wallpaper and fabrics match), sumptuous layering (throws and cushions galore), elegant mirrors and original art.

facts.text: Sea-facing rooms have views of passing ships, dolphins and sunsets.
facts.excerpt: Sea-facing rooms have views of passing ships, cavorting dolphins and the magnificent sunsets.

facts.text: Rooms on the upper floors have the best sea views.
facts.excerpt: Optimal sea views from rooms on the upper floors.

facts.text: The in-room toiletries, enriched with botanical extracts, are unique to Red Carnation hotels and can be bought in the spa.
facts.excerpt: Enriched with botanical extracts, the in-room toiletries are unique to Red Carnation hotels and available to purchase in the spa.

facts.text: There are two restaurants; the closest other restaurants are 15 minutes away by car in Camps Bay.
facts.excerpt: There are two restaurants, which is a good thing because the closest restaurants are 15 minutes away by car in Camps Bay.

facts.text: Azure restaurant has blue and white interiors and is suited to watching the sun set.
facts.excerpt: As extravagantly decorated as the guest rooms, Azure’s blue and white interiors would be a great date-night choice—a combo of watching the sun sink below the horizon, excellent cuisine and fabulous wines

facts.text: Azure serves wines from the owners' South African estate, Bouchard Finlayson.
facts.excerpt: try something from the owners’ South African estate, Bouchard Finlayson

facts.text: Azure offers tasting menus, including a vegan version.
facts.excerpt: His tasting menus (even a vegan version) are a treat, too.

facts.text: Breakfast includes complimentary freshly shucked oysters and bubbly.
facts.excerpt: especially if you enjoy the complimentary freshly shucked oysters and bubbly

facts.text: The mountain-facing cafe specializes in sushi and seafood.
facts.excerpt: The mountain-facing cafe now specializes in sushi and seafood.

facts.text: Afternoon tea is often themed, for example all things pink in October for breast cancer awareness.
facts.excerpt: Afternoon tea is often themed - for example, all things pink in October in aid of breast cancer awareness.

facts.text: The Leopard Bar has terrace tables for sundowner cocktails.
facts.excerpt: The Leopard Bar’s best tables are on the terrace for sundowner cocktails.

facts.text: The spa is tucked below the hotel and has a loyal local following.
facts.excerpt: The award-winning spa, tucked below the hotel, has a loyal local following.

facts.text: The hotel has two swimming pools.
facts.excerpt: There are two swimming pools

facts.text: The hotel has a 16-seat cinema with drinks, popcorn and candy.
facts.excerpt: and a cute 16-seat cinema (with drinks, popcorn and candy, of course)

facts.text: The hotel runs a complimentary all-day shuttle to the V&A Waterfront, about a 20-minute drive away.
facts.excerpt: The hotel runs a complimentary all-day shuttle to the V&A Waterfront, which is about a 20-minute drive away.

facts.text: Experiences include helicopter flights, mountain walks, High Tea by the Sea and treatments in an outdoor mountain spa gazebo.
facts.excerpt: Experiences range from exhilarating helicopter flights and mountain walks, to High Tea by the Sea or a treatment in an outdoor mountain spa gazebo.

facts.text: The V&A Waterfront, Camps Bay beaches, the Constantia Wine Route and Hout Bay are all within easy reach.
facts.excerpt: The V&A Waterfront, Camps Bay beaches, the historic Constantia Wine Route and Hout Bay are all within easy reach.

facts.text: The hotel has water-saving initiatives, waste and energy management, and has eliminated single-use plastics.
facts.excerpt: We have impressive water-saving initiatives, a system for the management of waste and energy consumption, and have eliminated single-use plastics from our operations.

facts.text: The hotel is located in the environs of a national park.
facts.excerpt: Our location in the environs of a national park demands diligent sustainability practices.

facts.text: Early morning traffic on the coastal road may disturb light sleepers.
facts.excerpt: I’ve heard that the sound of early morning traffic on the coastal road may be disturbing to light sleepers

facts.text: The hotel is isolated, or beautifully remote.
facts.excerpt: On the one hand it’s isolated, on the other it’s beautifully remote.

facts.text: In the 2026 Readers' Choice Awards the hotel was voted No. 4 Hotel in South Africa by Conde Nast Traveler US.
facts.excerpt: In the 2026 Readers’ Choice Awards, The Twelve Apostles Hotel and Spa was voted the No. 8 Hotel in Eastern & Southern Africa by Condé Nast Traveller UK, and the No. 4 Hotel in South Africa by Condé Nast Traveler US.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite was recognised in Elite Traveler's Elite Suites 2025.
facts.excerpt: The Presidential Suite at The Twelve Apostles Hotel and Spa is proud to have been recognised as part of Elite Traveler's prestigious Elite Suites 2025.

facts.text: The hotel was named among the inaugural recipients of the Conde Nast Traveller Triple Crown.
facts.excerpt: has been named among the inaugural recipients of the Condé Nast Traveller Triple Crown
